Senior Backend Engineer | Java & Spring Boot Specialist | Microservices Architect

cases.jd_text:
Overview:
OmniLogix Global is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Lead Backend Software Engineer to drive the development of our next-generation logistics platforms. You will lead a team of talented engineers, ensuring the robustness, scalability, and performance of our critical backend services that power global supply chains. This role requires a strong technical leader with a passion for innovation and a deep understanding of distributed systems.

Responsibilities:
- Lead the design, development, and deployment of scalable and high-performance backend services using Java and Spring Boot.
- Mentor and guide junior and mid-level engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence and continuous improvement.
- Architect and implement solutions for complex logistics challenges, optimizing for efficiency and reliability.
- Collaborate cross-functionally with product managers, frontend engineers, and operations teams to define and deliver features.
- Ensure best practices in coding, testing, and deployment are followed across the team.

Mandatory Requirements:
We are looking for candidates with at least 8 years of professional experience in backend software development, specifically with a strong emphasis on Java and the Spring Boot framework. A deep understanding of microservices architecture and experience designing and implementing highly available, fault-tolerant distributed systems is essential. Proficiency with relational databases like PostgreSQL, including schema design and query optimization, is also required. Furthermore, candidates must demonstrate prior experience leading technical projects or mentoring engineers, showcasing their leadership capabilities. Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, are critical for effective collaboration within our global teams.

Preferred Bonus:
Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure, particularly with services relevant to backend deployments (e.g., EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda), will be a significant advantage. Familiarity with event streaming technologies like Kafka is also highly desirable.

Benefits:
We offer a competitive salary, comprehensive health benefits, generous paid time off, and opportunities for professional development in a dynamic and supportive environment.

criteria.description: Thiết kế kiến trúc module Spring Boot có khả năng mở rộng và bảo trì cao
criteria.expected_evidence: Đưa ra quyết định về cấu trúc package, phân tách layer (Controller, Service, Repository) và giải thích lý do lựa chọn dựa trên yêu cầu nghiệp vụ.
criteria.below_target: Viết code monolithic không rõ ràng hoặc trộn lẫn logic nghiệp vụ với controller.
criteria.at_target: Áp dụng đúng các nguyên tắc SOLID trong thiết kế lớp dịch vụ và controller.
criteria.above_target: Đánh giá trade-off giữa việc sử dụng Microservices so với Modular Monolith cho quy mô dự án cụ thể.

criteria.description: Xử lý các vấn đề hiệu năng và đồng bộ hóa trong môi trường đa luồng của Spring Boot
criteria.expected_evidence: Phân tích các điểm nghẽn tiềm ẩn trong xử lý bất đồng bộ hoặc truy cập cơ sở dữ liệu và đề xuất giải pháp tối ưu.
criteria.below_target: Bỏ qua vấn đề race condition hoặc xử lý blocking thread trong request handler.
criteria.at_target: Sử dụng đúng các annotation như @Async hoặc CompletableFuture để xử lý bất đồng bộ.
criteria.above_target: Thiết kế cơ chế retry và circuit breaker để đảm bảo tính sẵn sàng khi phụ thuộc bên ngoài gặp sự cố.

jd_evidence_spans: at least 8 years of professional experience in backend software development, specifically with a strong emphasis on Java and the Spring Boot framework.

cases.scripted_answer: Với hơn 9 năm kinh nghiệm phát triển backend sử dụng Java và Spring Boot, tôi đã thiết kế nhiều kiến trúc module có khả năng mở rộng và bảo trì cao. Cụ thể, tôi luôn tuân thủ nguyên tắc phân tách rõ ràng các layer như Controller, Service và Repository, đảm bảo mỗi layer có một trách nhiệm duy nhất (Single Responsibility Principle). Trong các dự án gần đây, tôi đã áp dụng triệt để các nguyên tắc SOLID, ví dụ như sử dụng Dependency Inversion Principle để inject các interface service vào controller, giúp giảm sự phụ thuộc và tăng tính linh hoạt. Điều này cho phép dễ dàng thay đổi hoặc mở rộng logic nghiệp vụ mà không ảnh hưởng đến các thành phần khác, đồng thời giúp việc kiểm thử đơn vị trở nên hiệu quả hơn.

cases.scripted_answer: Với 8 năm kinh nghiệm phát triển backend Java và Spring Boot, tôi luôn ưu tiên thiết kế kiến trúc module có khả năng mở rộng và bảo trì cao. Cụ thể, tôi áp dụng cấu trúc package theo tính năng (feature-based) kết hợp với phân tách layer rõ ràng (Controller, Service, Repository, Domain) để đảm bảo tính cô lập và dễ quản lý. Trong các lớp Service, tôi tuân thủ chặt chẽ nguyên tắc SOLID, đặc biệt là Single Responsibility Principle (SRP) và Dependency Inversion Principle (DIP), để mỗi service chỉ chịu trách nhiệm cho một nghiệp vụ cụ thể và dễ dàng thay thế các dependency thông qua IoC của Spring. Đối với Controller, tôi đảm bảo chúng chỉ xử lý các yêu cầu HTTP và ủy quyền logic nghiệp vụ cho các Service, tuân thủ nguyên tắc Open/Closed Principle (OCP) khi mở rộng API. Tôi cũng có kinh nghiệm tối ưu hóa truy vấn PostgreSQL và sử dụng Redis để cải thiện hiệu suất.

Overview:
OmniLogix Global is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Lead Backend Software Engineer to drive the development of our next-generation logistics platforms. You will lead a team of talented engineers, ensuring the robustness, scalability, and performance of our critical backend services that power global supply chains. This role requires a strong technical leader with a passion for innovation and a deep understanding of distributed systems.

Responsibilities:
- Lead the design, development, and deployment of scalable and high-performance backend services using Java and Spring Boot.
- Mentor and guide junior and mid-level engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence and continuous improvement.
- Architect and implement solutions for complex logistics challenges, optimizing for efficiency and reliability.
- Collaborate cross-functionally with product managers, frontend engineers, and operations teams to define and deliver features.
- Ensure best practices in coding, testing, and deployment are followed across the team.

Mandatory Requirements:
We are looking for candidates with at least 8 years of professional experience in backend software development, specifically with a strong emphasis on Java and the Spring Boot framework. A deep understanding of microservices architecture and experience designing and implementing highly available, fault-tolerant distributed systems is essential. Proficiency with relational databases like PostgreSQL, including schema design and query optimization, is also required. Furthermore, candidates must demonstrate prior experience leading technical projects or mentoring engineers, showcasing their leadership capabilities. Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, are critical for effective collaboration within our global teams.

Preferred Bonus:
Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure, particularly with services relevant to backend deployments (e.g., EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda), will be a significant advantage. Familiarity with event streaming technologies like Kafka is also highly desirable.

Benefits:
We offer a competitive salary, comprehensive health benefits, generous paid time off, and opportunities for professional development in a dynamic and supportive environment.

cases.jd_text:
Connectify Innovations is at the forefront of revolutionizing the telecom landscape. We're a high-growth scale-up dedicated to building the next generation of communication platforms, making connectivity faster, more reliable, and accessible to everyone. Our mission is to empower seamless digital experiences, and we believe that starts with an exceptional user interface.

We're seeking a passionate and skilled Mid-Level Frontend Software Engineer to join our dynamic team. In this role, you'll be instrumental in shaping the user-facing aspects of our core telecom products, from intuitive dashboards for network management to delightful mobile applications that keep our users connected. You'll work closely with product designers, backend engineers, and other stakeholders to translate complex requirements into elegant, high-performance web and mobile interfaces. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to a product that impacts millions, leveraging modern technologies to solve challenging problems in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

**What You'll Do:
**
*   Develop and maintain robust, scalable, and responsive user interfaces for our web and mobile applications.
*   Collaborate with UX/UI designers to ensure technical feasibility of designs and deliver pixel-perfect implementations.
*   Write clean, well-documented, and testable code, adhering to best practices and coding standards.
*   Actively participate in code reviews, providing constructive feedback and learning from peers.
*   Troubleshoot and debug frontend issues, ensuring a smooth and reliable user experience.
*   Contribute to the architectural design and technology choices for new features and products.

**What We're Looking For (Mandatory):
**
To thrive in this role, you must possess at least **3 years of professional experience** in frontend development, primarily with **React.js and its ecosystem**. A strong command of **JavaScript (ES6+) and TypeScript** is essential, as is a deep understanding of **HTML5 and CSS3**, including responsive design principles. You should also have demonstrated experience consuming **RESTful APIs** and integrating them seamlessly into frontend applications. Finally, a solid grasp of **version control systems, particularly Git**, is non-negotiable for our collaborative development environment.

**What Would Be Great To Have (Preferred):
**
Candidates who also bring experience with **state management libraries like Redux or MobX** will find themselves quickly contributing to our complex applications. Any familiarity with **cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud** for deploying and managing frontend assets would be a significant plus, as we leverage these extensively.

cases.jd_text:
Connectify Innovations is at the forefront of revolutionizing the telecom landscape. We're a high-growth scale-up dedicated to building the next generation of communication platforms, making connectivity faster, more reliable, and accessible to everyone. Our mission is to empower seamless digital experiences, and we believe that starts with an exceptional user interface.

We're seeking a passionate and skilled Mid-Level Frontend Software Engineer to join our dynamic team. In this role, you'll be instrumental in shaping the user-facing aspects of our core telecom products, from intuitive dashboards for network management to delightful mobile applications that keep our users connected. You'll work closely with product designers, backend engineers, and other stakeholders to translate complex requirements into elegant, high-performance web and mobile interfaces. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to a product that impacts millions, leveraging modern technologies to solve challenging problems in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

**What You'll Do:
**
*   Develop and maintain robust, scalable, and responsive user interfaces for our web and mobile applications.
*   Collaborate with UX/UI designers to ensure technical feasibility of designs and deliver pixel-perfect implementations.
*   Write clean, well-documented, and testable code, adhering to best practices and coding standards.
*   Actively participate in code reviews, providing constructive feedback and learning from peers.
*   Troubleshoot and debug frontend issues, ensuring a smooth and reliable user experience.
*   Contribute to the architectural design and technology choices for new features and products.

**What We're Looking For (Mandatory):
**
To thrive in this role, you must possess at least **3 years of professional experience** in frontend development, primarily with **React.js and its ecosystem**. A strong command of **JavaScript (ES6+) and TypeScript** is essential, as is a deep understanding of **HTML5 and CSS3**, including responsive design principles. You should also have demonstrated experience consuming **RESTful APIs** and integrating them seamlessly into frontend applications. Finally, a solid grasp of **version control systems, particularly Git**, is non-negotiable for our collaborative development environment.

**What Would Be Great To Have (Preferred):
**
Candidates who also bring experience with **state management libraries like Redux or MobX** will find themselves quickly contributing to our complex applications. Any familiarity with **cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud** for deploying and managing frontend assets would be a significant plus, as we leverage these extensively.

cases.scripted_answer: Tôi có kinh nghiệm vững chắc với JavaScript (ES6+) và đang học TypeScript. Tôi thường xuyên áp dụng các tính năng ES6+ như arrow functions cho các hàm callback ngắn gọn, sử dụng destructuring để trích xuất dữ liệu từ object/array một cách hiệu quả, và dùng template literals để xây dựng chuỗi động dễ đọc hơn. Ví dụ, thay vì dùng `function(a, b) { return a + b; }`, tôi sẽ dùng `(a, b) => a + b;` và thay vì `const name = user.name; const age = user.age;`, tôi sẽ dùng `const { name, age } = user;` để code sạch và hiện đại hơn.

We're a high-growth scale-up dedicated to building the next generation of communication platforms, making connectivity faster, more reliable, and accessible to everyone. Our mission is to empower seamless digital experiences, and we believe that starts with an exceptional user interface.

We're seeking a passionate and skilled Mid-Level Frontend Software Engineer to join our dynamic team. In this role, you'll be instrumental in shaping the user-facing aspects of our core telecom products, from intuitive dashboards for network management to delightful mobile applications that keep our users connected. You'll work closely with product designers, backend engineers, and other stakeholders to translate complex requirements into elegant, high-performance web and mobile interfaces. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to a product that impacts millions, leveraging modern technologies to solve challenging problems in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

**What You'll Do:
**
*   Develop and maintain robust, scalable, and responsive user interfaces for our web and mobile applications.
*   Collaborate with UX/UI designers to ensure technical feasibility of designs and deliver pixel-perfect implementations.
*   Write clean, well-documented, and testable code, adhering to best practices and coding standards.
*   Actively participate in code reviews, providing constructive feedback and learning from peers.
*   Troubleshoot and debug frontend issues, ensuring a smooth and reliable user experience.
*   Contribute to the architectural design and technology choices for new features and products.

**What We're Looking For (Mandatory):
**
To thrive in this role, you must possess at least **3 years of professional experience** in frontend development, primarily with **React.js and its ecosystem**. A strong command of **JavaScript (ES6+) and TypeScript** is essential, as is a deep understanding of **HTML5 and CSS3**, including responsive design principles. You should also have demonstrated experience consuming **RESTful APIs** and integrating them seamlessly into frontend applications. Finally, a solid grasp of **version control systems, particularly Git**, is non-negotiable for our collaborative development environment.

**What Would Be Great To Have (Preferred):
**
Candidates who also bring experience with **state management libraries like Redux or MobX** will find themselves quickly contributing to our complex applications. Any familiarity with **cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud** for deploying and managing frontend assets would be a significant plus, as we leverage these extensively.

criteria.expected_evidence: Định nghĩa interface/type cho dữ liệu đầu vào/ra và sử dụng chúng trong hàm.
criteria.below_target: Không dùng type annotations hoặc dùng `any` bừa bãi.
criteria.at_target: Thêm type definitions cơ bản cho các tham số và giá trị trả về của hàm.
criteria.above_target: Sử dụng generic types hoặc utility types để tái sử dụng logic với nhiều kiểu dữ liệu khác nhau.

cases.scripted_answer: Tôi có kinh nghiệm sâu rộng với JavaScript (ES6+) và TypeScript, đã áp dụng thành thạo các tính năng hiện đại trong nhiều dự án thực tế. Cụ thể, tôi thường xuyên sử dụng arrow functions cho các callback để giữ ngữ cảnh `this` và viết mã ngắn gọn hơn, ví dụ như trong các phương thức `map`, `filter` của array. Destructuring assignment được tôi dùng để trích xuất thuộc tính từ object hoặc phần tử từ array một cách hiệu quả, đặc biệt khi làm việc với props trong React hoặc kết quả trả về từ API. Ngoài ra, template literals là công cụ không thể thiếu để xây dựng chuỗi động, giúp mã dễ đọc và dễ bảo trì hơn so với nối chuỗi truyền thống.

cases.scripted_answer: Với 3 năm kinh nghiệm phát triển frontend, tôi đã thành thạo React.js và hệ sinh thái của nó. Tôi thường xuyên sử dụng TypeScript để định nghĩa các interface cho props, đảm bảo type checking chặt chẽ khi xây dựng các component React. Ví dụ, tôi đã phát triển một `UserTable` component nhận vào `users: User[]` thông qua props, nơi `User` là một interface được định nghĩa rõ ràng, và render dữ liệu này bằng JSX kết hợp với các tính năng ES6+ như destructuring và arrow functions. Git là công cụ không thể thiếu trong quy trình làm việc nhóm của tôi.

cases.jd_text:
Connectify Innovations is at the forefront of revolutionizing the telecom landscape. We're a high-growth scale-up dedicated to building the next generation of communication platforms, making connectivity faster, more reliable, and accessible to everyone. Our mission is to empower seamless digital experiences, and we believe that starts with an exceptional user interface.

We're seeking a passionate and skilled Mid-Level Frontend Software Engineer to join our dynamic team. In this role, you'll be instrumental in shaping the user-facing aspects of our core telecom products, from intuitive dashboards for network management to delightful mobile applications that keep our users connected. You'll work closely with product designers, backend engineers, and other stakeholders to translate complex requirements into elegant, high-performance web and mobile interfaces. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to a product that impacts millions, leveraging modern technologies to solve challenging problems in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

**What You'll Do:
**
*   Develop and maintain robust, scalable, and responsive user interfaces for our web and mobile applications.
*   Collaborate with UX/UI designers to ensure technical feasibility of designs and deliver pixel-perfect implementations.
*   Write clean, well-documented, and testable code, adhering to best practices and coding standards.
*   Actively participate in code reviews, providing constructive feedback and learning from peers.
*   Troubleshoot and debug frontend issues, ensuring a smooth and reliable user experience.
*   Contribute to the architectural design and technology choices for new features and products.

**What We're Looking For (Mandatory):
**
To thrive in this role, you must possess at least **3 years of professional experience** in frontend development, primarily with **React.js and its ecosystem**. A strong command of **JavaScript (ES6+) and TypeScript** is essential, as is a deep understanding of **HTML5 and CSS3**, including responsive design principles. You should also have demonstrated experience consuming **RESTful APIs** and integrating them seamlessly into frontend applications. Finally, a solid grasp of **version control systems, particularly Git**, is non-negotiable for our collaborative development environment.

**What Would Be Great To Have (Preferred):
**
Candidates who also bring experience with **state management libraries like Redux or MobX** will find themselves quickly contributing to our complex applications. Any familiarity with **cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud** for deploying and managing frontend assets would be a significant plus, as we leverage these extensively.

Join ApexFlow Labs, a high-growth fintech scale-up revolutionizing capital markets access! cases.jd_text:
Join ApexFlow Labs, a high-growth fintech scale-up revolutionizing capital markets access! We're building cutting-edge platforms that empower investors and financial institutions with unparalleled speed and insight. Our mission? To democratize sophisticated financial tools and drive innovation in a historically opaque industry. We move fast, iterate constantly, and celebrate bold ideas.

We're searching for a driven Junior Full-Stack Software Engineer ready to make an immediate impact. This isn't a coffee-fetching role – you'll be contributing to core features from day one, working across our modern tech stack. You'll collaborate closely with product managers and senior engineers to design, develop, and deploy robust, scalable solutions that directly affect our users.

What you'll do:
* Build and maintain scalable APIs and microservices using Python (FastAPI/Django).
* Develop responsive and intuitive front-end interfaces with React and TypeScript.
* Write high-quality, testable code and participate in code reviews to ensure best practices.
* Troubleshoot and debug production issues, ensuring system stability and performance.
* Contribute to architectural discussions and continuous improvement initiatives.

What you bring:
To hit the ground running, you absolutely need at least 1-2 years of professional experience in full-stack development. A strong grasp of Python for backend development, coupled with practical experience in a modern JavaScript framework like React, is mandatory. You must also be proficient with relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL) and have a solid understanding of RESTful API principles. We expect you to be comfortable with Git-based version control and CI/CD pipelines. Crucially, a demonstrated passion for fintech or complex data systems will set you apart.

Ideally, you'll also have some exposure to cloud platforms like AWS or GCP, as we leverage these heavily. Experience with Docker or Kubernetes for containerization is a significant plus. Familiarity with GraphQL or asynchronous messaging systems (e.g., Kafka) would be fantastic, as would any contributions to open-source projects or a strong portfolio showcasing your personal coding projects. If you thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment and are eager to learn and grow, ApexFlow is your next home.

AuraHealth Innovations is revolutionizing patient engagement through intelligent, accessible mobile platforms. We're a high-growth scale-up in the digital healthcare space, seeking a Junior Mobile Software Engineer to join our cross-functional team. You'll contribute directly to the development of our flagship iOS and Android applications, impacting millions of users.

We're looking for someone with a foundational understanding of mobile application development principles. This role offers an exciting opportunity to grow your skills in a fast-paced, impact-driven environment, working on a modern tech stack. We prioritize collaborative problem-solving and continuous learning.

cases.scripted_answer: Trong vai trò của mình, tôi đã sử dụng Fastlane và Bitrise để xây dựng các pipeline CI/CD tự động hóa quy trình tích hợp và triển khai. Cụ thể, khi có thay đổi trong schema hoặc query GraphQL, pipeline sẽ tự động kích hoạt. Các bước bao gồm chạy các bài kiểm thử đơn vị và kiểm thử tích hợp để đảm bảo các thay đổi GraphQL không phá vỡ các chức năng hiện có. Sau đó, pipeline sẽ thực hiện kiểm tra cú pháp và xác thực schema GraphQL bằng các công cụ như Apollo CLI hoặc GraphQL Inspector để đảm bảo tính hợp lệ và tương thích ngược. Cuối cùng, nếu tất cả các kiểm thử và xác thực đều thành công, pipeline sẽ tiến hành build ứng dụng và triển khai lên môi trường staging hoặc production.

NebulaFlow Technologies is an innovative SaaS scale-up building a next-generation data orchestration platform. We're looking for a passionate Junior DevOps Engineer to join our growing infrastructure team and help us scale our cloud-native services. This role is crucial for maintaining the reliability and performance of our core platform.

As a Junior DevOps Engineer, you'll be instrumental in automating our deployment pipelines, managing our Kubernetes clusters, and ensuring our infrastructure is robust and observable. You'll work closely with our Senior DevOps and Software Engineers, gaining hands-on experience with cutting-edge cloud technologies.

We need someone with a foundational understanding of cloud platforms, specifically AWS, including services like EC2, S3, RDS, and VPC. Your day-to-day will involve contributing to our infrastructure-as-code (IaC) efforts using Terraform, so prior exposure to Terraform or a similar IaC tool is essential. Experience with containerization technologies, particularly Docker, and orchestrators like Kubernetes, is a must-have for this role. You should also be comfortable with Linux environments and possess strong scripting skills in Python or Bash for automation tasks. A solid grasp of CI/CD principles and experience with tools like GitLab CI/CD or Jenkins is highly valued.

Ideally, you'll also have some familiarity with monitoring and logging tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, or ELK stack, as well as an understanding of network fundamentals (DNS, HTTP/S, TCP/IP). Any exposure to Go or other backend languages would be a plus, as we occasionally contribute to internal tooling development. This is an excellent opportunity to accelerate your career in a fast-paced, engineering-first environment.

cases.scripted_answer: Để lưu trữ các đối tượng bất biến như hình ảnh, video hoặc tài liệu, tôi sẽ chọn Amazon S3 (Simple Storage Service). S3 là dịch vụ lưu trữ đối tượng có độ bền cao (99.999999999% - 11 số 9), khả năng mở rộng gần như vô hạn và chi phí hiệu quả, rất phù hợp cho các trường hợp sử dụng này. Dữ liệu được lưu trữ dưới dạng đối tượng trong các bucket, mỗi đối tượng có một khóa duy nhất và có thể được truy cập thông qua API hoặc URL.

NebulaFlow Technologies is an innovative SaaS scale-up building a next-generation data orchestration platform. We're looking for a passionate Junior DevOps Engineer to join our growing infrastructure team and help us scale our cloud-native services. This role is crucial for maintaining the reliability and performance of our core platform.

As a Junior DevOps Engineer, you'll be instrumental in automating our deployment pipelines, managing our Kubernetes clusters, and ensuring our infrastructure is robust and observable. You'll work closely with our Senior DevOps and Software Engineers, gaining hands-on experience with cutting-edge cloud technologies.

We need someone with a foundational understanding of cloud platforms, specifically AWS, including services like EC2, S3, RDS, and VPC. Your day-to-day will involve contributing to our infrastructure-as-code (IaC) efforts using Terraform, so prior exposure to Terraform or a similar IaC tool is essential. Experience with containerization technologies, particularly Docker, and orchestrators like Kubernetes, is a must-have for this role. You should also be comfortable with Linux environments and possess strong scripting skills in Python or Bash for automation tasks. A solid grasp of CI/CD principles and experience with tools like GitLab CI/CD or Jenkins is highly valued.

Ideally, you'll also have some familiarity with monitoring and logging tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, or ELK stack, as well as an understanding of network fundamentals (DNS, HTTP/S, TCP/IP). Any exposure to Go or other backend languages would be a plus, as we occasionally contribute to internal tooling development. This is an excellent opportunity to accelerate your career in a fast-paced, engineering-first environment.

cases.scripted_answer: Tôi có kinh nghiệm viết Dockerfile đa giai đoạn (multi-stage Dockerfile) để tối ưu hóa kích thước image. Cụ thể, tôi sẽ sử dụng một giai đoạn `builder` với các công cụ phát triển đầy đủ để biên dịch mã nguồn và tạo ra các artifact. Sau đó, ở giai đoạn `runtime` cuối cùng, tôi chỉ sử dụng một base image tối thiểu (ví dụ: `alpine`) và sao chép (COPY) các artifact đã được biên dịch từ giai đoạn `builder` vào, đảm bảo image cuối cùng chỉ chứa những gì cần thiết để chạy ứng dụng, giảm đáng kể dung lượng và tăng cường bảo mật.

Overview:
PixelForge Games is an innovative early-stage startup building the next generation of immersive gaming experiences. We're looking for a highly skilled and passionate Senior Data Engineer to join our growing team. You'll be instrumental in designing, building, and maintaining the data infrastructure that powers our game analytics, player insights, and operational reporting. This is a unique opportunity to shape our data strategy from the ground up and make a significant impact on our product and business success.

Responsibilities:
* Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines using Python to ingest, transform, and load data from various game services, databases, and third-party APIs.
* Build and optimize robust ETL/ELT processes, ensuring data quality, reliability, and performance.
* Collaborate closely with game developers, product managers, and data scientists to understand data needs and deliver effective data solutions.
* Implement and manage data warehousing solutions, leveraging cloud platforms like AWS, GCP, or Azure.
* Develop and enforce data governance policies, security standards, and best practices.
* Monitor data infrastructure, troubleshoot issues, and implement proactive solutions to ensure high availability and data integrity.
* Champion data-driven decision-making across the organization.

Mandatory Requirements:
To thrive in this role, you must have a minimum of 5 years of professional experience in data engineering, with a strong focus on building data pipelines. Expertise in Python for data manipulation and automation is essential. You should possess extensive experience with SQL and relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL) and a solid understanding of data warehousing concepts. Practical experience with cloud data platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) is also a must-have, specifically with services like S3, Redshift, BigQuery, or Snowflake. Finally, a proven track record of designing and implementing ETL/ELT processes is critical for this position.

Preferred Bonus:
Experience within the gaming industry or with high-volume real-time data streams will be a significant advantage. Familiarity with streaming technologies such as Kafka or Kinesis would also be highly beneficial. Any prior experience with containerization technologies like Docker or orchestration tools like Kubernetes is a plus.

Benefits:
We offer a competitive salary, equity options, comprehensive health benefits, unlimited PTO, a flexible remote-first work environment, and opportunities for professional development. Join us and help craft the future of gaming!

cases.scripted_answer: Tôi có kinh nghiệm sâu rộng trong việc sử dụng Python để thao tác và tự động hóa dữ liệu, đặc biệt là với các tập dữ liệu lớn. Tôi thường xuyên sử dụng thư viện Pandas để lọc và chuyển đổi DataFrame một cách hiệu quả, tận dụng các phương thức vector hóa như `df.loc[]` để lọc theo điều kiện hoặc `df.apply()` với các hàm lambda để biến đổi cột, giúp tối ưu hóa hiệu suất và bộ nhớ. Đối với các luồng dữ liệu sự kiện lớn hoặc khi cần xử lý dữ liệu theo từng phần để tiết kiệm bộ nhớ, tôi triển khai các generator trong Python để xử lý dữ liệu theo từng khối (chunk) thay vì tải toàn bộ vào bộ nhớ cùng lúc. Điều này đảm bảo rằng các quy trình xử lý dữ liệu của tôi luôn hiệu quả và có khả năng mở rộng.

cases.jd_text:
Overview:
PixelForge Games is an innovative early-stage startup building the next generation of immersive gaming experiences. We're looking for a highly skilled and passionate Senior Data Engineer to join our growing team. You'll be instrumental in designing, building, and maintaining the data infrastructure that powers our game analytics, player insights, and operational reporting. This is a unique opportunity to shape our data strategy from the ground up and make a significant impact on our product and business success.

Responsibilities:
* Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines using Python to ingest, transform, and load data from various game services, databases, and third-party APIs.
* Build and optimize robust ETL/ELT processes, ensuring data quality, reliability, and performance.
* Collaborate closely with game developers, product managers, and data scientists to understand data needs and deliver effective data solutions.
* Implement and manage data warehousing solutions, leveraging cloud platforms like AWS, GCP, or Azure.
* Develop and enforce data governance policies, security standards, and best practices.
* Monitor data infrastructure, troubleshoot issues, and implement proactive solutions to ensure high availability and data integrity.
* Champion data-driven decision-making across the organization.

Mandatory Requirements:
To thrive in this role, you must have a minimum of 5 years of professional experience in data engineering, with a strong focus on building data pipelines. Expertise in Python for data manipulation and automation is essential. You should possess extensive experience with SQL and relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL) and a solid understanding of data warehousing concepts. Practical experience with cloud data platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) is also a must-have, specifically with services like S3, Redshift, BigQuery, or Snowflake. Finally, a proven track record of designing and implementing ETL/ELT processes is critical for this position.

Preferred Bonus:
Experience within the gaming industry or with high-volume real-time data streams will be a significant advantage. Familiarity with streaming technologies such as Kafka or Kinesis would also be highly beneficial. Any prior experience with containerization technologies like Docker or orchestration tools like Kubernetes is a plus.

Benefits:
We offer a competitive salary, equity options, comprehensive health benefits, unlimited PTO, a flexible remote-first work environment, and opportunities for professional development. Join us and help craft the future of gaming!

cases.scripted_answer: Trong vai trò Kỹ sư Dữ liệu, tôi thường xuyên đánh giá sự đánh đổi giữa xử lý theo lô (batch) và thời gian thực (streaming) dựa trên yêu cầu kinh doanh cụ thể. Đối với các tác vụ yêu cầu độ trễ cao và dữ liệu cần được cập nhật liên tục, ví dụ như theo dõi hành vi người dùng trong ngành game để phát hiện gian lận hoặc cá nhân hóa trải nghiệm ngay lập tức, tôi ưu tiên sử dụng xử lý streaming với các công nghệ như Apache Kafka hoặc Amazon Kinesis. Điều này đảm bảo dữ liệu được thu thập, xử lý và phân tích gần như tức thì, cho phép đưa ra quyết định kinh doanh kịp thời. Ngược lại, đối với các tác vụ không yêu cầu độ trễ thấp, ví dụ như báo cáo cuối ngày, phân tích lịch sử dữ liệu lớn (ví dụ: tổng hợp dữ liệu bán hàng hàng tháng) hoặc các quy trình ETL/ELT định kỳ để nạp dữ liệu vào data warehouse (như Snowflake hoặc Redshift), tôi sẽ chọn xử lý theo lô. Phương pháp này giúp tối ưu hóa chi phí tính toán bằng cách tận dụng tài nguyên hiệu quả hơn trong các khoảng thời gian không cao điểm và xử lý một lượng lớn dữ liệu cùng lúc, giảm thiểu chi phí vận hành.

Overview:
PixelForge Games is an innovative early-stage startup building the next generation of immersive gaming experiences. We're looking for a highly skilled and passionate Senior Data Engineer to join our growing team. You'll be instrumental in designing, building, and maintaining the data infrastructure that powers our game analytics, player insights, and operational reporting. This is a unique opportunity to shape our data strategy from the ground up and make a significant impact on our product and business success.

Responsibilities:
* Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines using Python to ingest, transform, and load data from various game services, databases, and third-party APIs.
* Build and optimize robust ETL/ELT processes, ensuring data quality, reliability, and performance.
* Collaborate closely with game developers, product managers, and data scientists to understand data needs and deliver effective data solutions.
* Implement and manage data warehousing solutions, leveraging cloud platforms like AWS, GCP, or Azure.
* Develop and enforce data governance policies, security standards, and best practices.
* Monitor data infrastructure, troubleshoot issues, and implement proactive solutions to ensure high availability and data integrity.
* Champion data-driven decision-making across the organization.

Mandatory Requirements:
To thrive in this role, you must have a minimum of 5 years of professional experience in data engineering, with a strong focus on building data pipelines. Expertise in Python for data manipulation and automation is essential. You should possess extensive experience with SQL and relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL) and a solid understanding of data warehousing concepts. Practical experience with cloud data platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) is also a must-have, specifically with services like S3, Redshift, BigQuery, or Snowflake. Finally, a proven track record of designing and implementing ETL/ELT processes is critical for this position.

Preferred Bonus:
Experience within the gaming industry or with high-volume real-time data streams will be a significant advantage. Familiarity with streaming technologies such as Kafka or Kinesis would also be highly beneficial. Any prior experience with containerization technologies like Docker or orchestration tools like Kubernetes is a plus.

Benefits:
We offer a competitive salary, equity options, comprehensive health benefits, unlimited PTO, a flexible remote-first work environment, and opportunities for professional development. Join us and help craft the future of gaming!

cases.scripted_answer: Tôi có kinh nghiệm sử dụng Python để thao tác và tự động hóa dữ liệu, đặc biệt là với thư viện pandas. Đối với các tập dữ liệu cực lớn không thể tải toàn bộ vào bộ nhớ, tôi sử dụng các generator hoặc đọc từng phần bằng `pd.read_csv(chunksize=...)` để xử lý dữ liệu theo từng khối, đảm bảo tối ưu hóa bộ nhớ và hiệu suất.

cases.jd_text:
At Quantify Innovations, we're not just building software; we're crafting the future of financial technology. Our mission is to empower leading banks and financial institutions with cutting-edge AI and machine learning solutions that drive efficiency, enhance security, and unlock new growth opportunities. We pride ourselves on a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning, tackling complex challenges with a diverse and talented team.

We are seeking an exceptional Lead Data Scientist to join our dynamic team, focusing on high-impact projects within the banking sector. In this pivotal role, you will lead the design, development, and deployment of advanced machine learning models, from predictive analytics for risk assessment to personalized customer experiences. You'll work closely with clients to understand their unique needs, translate business problems into technical solutions, and mentor junior data scientists, fostering their growth and ensuring best practices are followed across the board. Your expertise will directly influence the strategic direction of our client engagements and product development.

To thrive in this role, you must possess a robust foundation in machine learning principles and statistical modeling, coupled with extensive hands-on experience in Python and its data science ecosystem (e.g., scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch). A minimum of 7 years in a data science or machine learning engineering role, with at least 3 years specifically within the financial services industry, is essential. We are looking for someone with a proven track record of delivering end-to-end ML solutions into production environments. Experience with cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or GCP is also a critical requirement, as our solutions are often cloud-native. Furthermore, strong communication skills are indispensable for effective client interaction and team leadership, enabling you to clearly articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. Familiarity with MLOps practices, including model versioning, monitoring, and deployment pipelines, will be highly regarded. Ideally, you will also have experience with big data technologies such as Spark or Hadoop, and a deep understanding of financial regulations (e.g., Basel, AML, KYC) or specific banking domains like credit risk or fraud detection. A Master's or Ph.D. in a quantitative field (e.g., Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics) is a significant plus.

cases.jd_text:
QuibbleMarket is revolutionizing online impulse buying, leveraging cutting-edge microservices architecture to deliver a seamless, high-velocity e-commerce experience. As we scale rapidly, the integrity and reliability of our platform are paramount. We're seeking a passionate Mid-Level Test Automation Engineer to embed within our product squads and champion quality from concept to deployment.

You will be instrumental in designing, building, and maintaining robust automated test suites across our diverse service landscape, which includes our frontend customer portal, backend fulfillment systems, and critical payment gateways. This role demands a strong understanding of modern testing methodologies and a hands-on approach to problem-solving.

Key responsibilities include developing and extending our Cypress-based E2E test framework for our React/TypeScript frontend, integrating API tests using Postman/Newman into our CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI), and contributing to performance testing initiatives with k6. You will also be responsible for establishing effective data mocking strategies for complex test scenarios and actively participating in code reviews to ensure testability.

We require a minimum of 3 years of experience in test automation, specifically with JavaScript/TypeScript, and a proven track record of implementing and maintaining E2E test frameworks (Cypress preferred). You should also possess solid experience with API testing tools (e.g., Postman, RestAssured) and understand CI/CD integration principles. Familiarity with microservices architectures and cloud platforms (AWS) is essential, as is a strong grasp of SQL for database validation. We also expect a foundational understanding of performance testing concepts.

Ideally, you will have experience with contract testing frameworks (e.g., Pact) to ensure robust service-to-service communication. Any prior experience working with Kafka-based event streaming architectures and a good understanding of observability tools (e.g., Datadog, Prometheus) for post-deployment validation would be a significant advantage. If you're eager to make a tangible impact on a high-traffic, evolving e-commerce platform, we want to hear from you.

Experienced in performance testing methodologies and contract testing frameworks like Pact, ensuring reliability and scalability of applications. cases.scripted_answer: Với Cypress, tôi đã thiết kế cấu trúc framework theo mô hình Page Object Model (POM) để tối ưu hóa khả năng tái sử dụng và dễ bảo trì. Cụ thể, tôi tạo các thư mục riêng biệt như `cypress/pages` để chứa các file định nghĩa element và action của từng trang (ví dụ: `LoginPage.js`, `DashboardPage.js`), và `cypress/integration` để chứa các test spec files. Mỗi test spec file sẽ import và sử dụng các phương thức từ các page object tương ứng, giúp tách biệt rõ ràng logic của trang và các bước kiểm thử, đảm bảo tính mô đun hóa cao và dễ dàng cập nhật khi giao diện người dùng thay đổi.

Nhờ vậy, tôi đã có thể đóng góp hiệu quả vào việc triển khai microservice chính thức chỉ trong tuần tiếp theo.

cases.scripted_answer: Để xác minh trạng thái kết nối TCP trên Linux, tôi sẽ sử dụng lệnh `netstat -tulnp` hoặc `ss -tulnp`. Lệnh này sẽ hiển thị tất cả các cổng đang lắng nghe (LISTEN) và các kết nối đã được thiết lập (ESTABLISHED), cùng với các thông tin chi tiết như địa chỉ IP cục bộ/từ xa và PID của tiến trình. Ví dụ, nếu tôi thấy một kết nối với trạng thái `ESTABLISHED` trên cổng 80 đến một địa chỉ IP cụ thể, điều đó xác nhận rằng có một phiên TCP đang hoạt động. Ngược lại, trạng thái `LISTEN` cho biết dịch vụ đang chờ kết nối đến.

We're an early-stage startup with a lean, but impactful, engineering team. We're looking for a proactive Junior Security Analyst to join us and help secure our critical cloud infrastructure and endpoint environments. This role is instrumental in maturing our security posture from the ground up, ensuring patient data integrity and system resilience.

Your primary focus will be on operational security tasks, including incident response triage, vulnerability management, and access control enforcement. You will be responsible for monitoring security events across our AWS environment (EC2, S3, RDS) and corporate endpoints (macOS, Linux), identifying suspicious activity, and escalating critical alerts. A strong understanding of network protocols (TCP/IP, DNS) and foundational Linux command-line skills are essential. You will regularly utilize SIEM tools (e.g., Splunk, ELK) for log analysis and security information correlation. Experience with scripting languages like Python or Bash for automation of security tasks is highly valued. Familiarity with HIPAA compliance frameworks and security best practices for healthcare data is a significant plus. You should be comfortable with basic threat modeling concepts and able to contribute to security documentation. We're a fast-paced environment, so adaptability and a drive to learn new technologies are key.

cases.scripted_answer: Để xác minh trạng thái kết nối TCP trên Linux, tôi sẽ sử dụng lệnh `ss -tuna` hoặc `netstat -tuna`. Lệnh này sẽ hiển thị tất cả các kết nối TCP (t) và UDP (u), bao gồm cả các cổng đang lắng nghe (l) và các kết nối đã thiết lập (n). Tôi sẽ phân tích cột 'State' trong đầu ra để xác định trạng thái cụ thể của từng kết nối, ví dụ như 'ESTABLISHED' cho các kết nối đang hoạt động, 'LISTEN' cho các dịch vụ đang chờ kết nối, hoặc 'TIME_WAIT' cho các kết nối đang trong quá trình đóng. Điều này giúp tôi nhanh chóng đánh giá tình hình mạng và các dịch vụ đang chạy.

InnovateLearn Solutions is a dynamic software agency dedicated to crafting innovative digital learning experiences for a diverse range of educational clients. We pride ourselves on building robust, scalable, and user-centric platforms that transform how people learn. We are currently seeking a talented and driven Mid-Level Technical Product Manager / Business Analyst to join our growing team.

As a Technical Product Manager / Business Analyst, you will be a pivotal link between our clients' educational vision and our development team's technical execution. You will be responsible for translating complex business needs into clear, actionable technical requirements and ensuring the successful delivery of high-quality software solutions for the edtech sector. This role offers a unique opportunity to shape the future of learning technologies.

**Responsibilities:**
*   Collaborate with clients and stakeholders to gather, analyze, and define product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
*   Conduct in-depth business analysis to understand client workflows, pain points, and opportunities for digital transformation within educational contexts.
*   Translate functional requirements into detailed technical specifications, wireframes, and prototypes.
*   Work closely with development, QA, and UX/UI teams throughout the entire software development lifecycle.
*   Facilitate workshops, sprint planning, and backlog grooming sessions.
*   Ensure alignment between business objectives and technical solutions.
*   Act as a subject matter expert for the products you manage, providing guidance and support to internal teams and clients.
*   Contribute to user acceptance testing (UAT) and post-launch analysis.

**Mandatory Requirements:**
To excel in this role, you must possess at least 3 years of demonstrable experience as a Product Owner, Business Analyst, or Technical Product Manager, specifically within a software development environment. A strong understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) is essential. We require proven experience working with JIRA or similar project management tools to manage backlogs and track progress effectively. You should have excellent communication and interpersonal skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and vice-versa. Furthermore, a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, or a related field is a must-have. Finally, candidates must have prior experience translating business requirements into detailed technical specifications, including user stories, use cases, and acceptance criteria.

**Preferred Bonus:**
While not strictly required, prior experience within the EdTech industry, working on learning management systems (LMS), online course platforms, or educational content delivery systems, would be a significant advantage. Additionally, certifications such as CSPO (Certified Scrum Product Owner) or CBAP (Certified Business Analysis Professional) are highly valued.

**Benefits:**
*   Competitive salary and performance bonuses.
*   Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance.
*   Generous paid time off and flexible working arrangements.
*   Professional development budget for courses and certifications.
*   Opportunity to work on impactful projects that shape the future of education.
*   Collaborative and supportive team culture.
*   Modern office space with amenities (when applicable).
*   Company-sponsored social events and team-building activities.

cases.scripted_answer: Trong vai trò Quản lý sản phẩm, tôi đã sử dụng ClickUp, một công cụ quản lý dự án tương tự JIRA, để quản lý hiệu quả backlog cho hai ứng dụng SaaS. Điều này giúp đội ngũ phát triển dễ dàng nắm bắt thông tin, ưu tiên công việc và theo dõi tiến độ một cách hiệu quả.

cases.jd_text:
InnovateLearn Solutions is a dynamic software agency dedicated to crafting innovative digital learning experiences for a diverse range of educational clients. We pride ourselves on building robust, scalable, and user-centric platforms that transform how people learn. We are currently seeking a talented and driven Mid-Level Technical Product Manager / Business Analyst to join our growing team.

As a Technical Product Manager / Business Analyst, you will be a pivotal link between our clients' educational vision and our development team's technical execution. You will be responsible for translating complex business needs into clear, actionable technical requirements and ensuring the successful delivery of high-quality software solutions for the edtech sector. This role offers a unique opportunity to shape the future of learning technologies.

**Responsibilities:**
*   Collaborate with clients and stakeholders to gather, analyze, and define product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
*   Conduct in-depth business analysis to understand client workflows, pain points, and opportunities for digital transformation within educational contexts.
*   Translate functional requirements into detailed technical specifications, wireframes, and prototypes.
*   Work closely with development, QA, and UX/UI teams throughout the entire software development lifecycle.
*   Facilitate workshops, sprint planning, and backlog grooming sessions.
*   Ensure alignment between business objectives and technical solutions.
*   Act as a subject matter expert for the products you manage, providing guidance and support to internal teams and clients.
*   Contribute to user acceptance testing (UAT) and post-launch analysis.

**Mandatory Requirements:**
To excel in this role, you must possess at least 3 years of demonstrable experience as a Product Owner, Business Analyst, or Technical Product Manager, specifically within a software development environment. A strong understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) is essential. We require proven experience working with JIRA or similar project management tools to manage backlogs and track progress effectively. You should have excellent communication and interpersonal skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and vice-versa. Furthermore, a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, or a related field is a must-have. Finally, candidates must have prior experience translating business requirements into detailed technical specifications, including user stories, use cases, and acceptance criteria.

**Preferred Bonus:**
While not strictly required, prior experience within the EdTech industry, working on learning management systems (LMS), online course platforms, or educational content delivery systems, would be a significant advantage. Additionally, certifications such as CSPO (Certified Scrum Product Owner) or CBAP (Certified Business Analysis Professional) are highly valued.

**Benefits:**
*   Competitive salary and performance bonuses.
*   Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance.
*   Generous paid time off and flexible working arrangements.
*   Professional development budget for courses and certifications.
*   Opportunity to work on impactful projects that shape the future of education.
*   Collaborative and supportive team culture.
*   Modern office space with amenities (when applicable).
*   Company-sponsored social events and team-building activities.

criteria.expected_evidence: Chuyển trạng thái ticket sang 'In Progress' hoặc 'Done' kèm ghi chú ngắn gọn về kết quả.
criteria.below_target: Chỉ thay đổi trạng thái mà không giải thích lý do hoặc kết quả.
criteria.at_target: Cập nhật trạng thái đúng quy trình và thêm ghi chú tóm tắt công việc đã làm.
criteria.above_target: Liên kết ticket với commit code hoặc pull request tương ứng.

objectives.claim: We require proven experience working with JIRA or similar project management tools to manage backlogs and track progress effectively.
jd_evidence_spans: We require proven experience working with JIRA or similar project management tools to manage backlogs and track progress effectively.

cases.scripted_answer: Tôi có kinh nghiệm sâu rộng trong việc sử dụng Jira để quản lý backlog và theo dõi tiến độ dự án. Cụ thể, tôi thường xuyên tạo các ticket mới trong Jira, đảm bảo mỗi ticket có tiêu đề rõ ràng, mô tả chi tiết yêu cầu, và được gán đúng mức độ ưu tiên (ví dụ: Highest, High, Medium) dựa trên tác động và tính cấp thiết của công việc. Ngoài ra, tôi luôn gắn nhãn (label) phù hợp cho các ticket (ví dụ: 'Bug', 'Feature', 'Improvement', 'Frontend', 'Backend') để dễ dàng phân loại và tìm kiếm, đồng thời thiết lập trạng thái ban đầu chính xác như 'To Do' hoặc 'Open' ngay khi tạo. Việc này giúp đảm bảo thông tin đầy đủ và nhất quán, hỗ trợ hiệu quả cho việc lập kế hoạch và theo dõi tiến độ.
